remarks: This sun drenched 3 Br townhouse has just been renovated. Brand new Kitchen with new tile floor, new quartz countertops and new appliances, Refinished hardwood floors, fresh paint throughout, brand new carpet and freshly updated 1.5 Baths. Kitchen adjacent to Dining room and large living room. Finished lower level with brand new carpet. Laundry in the unit, a nice outdoor deck, Heat included in the rent. Gleaming hardwood floors. One off street parking space. Landlord requires 700 credit score min from all applicants
